use: src/data/localPortraits.js via src/ui/portraitArt.js: the face of a procedural station-bar contact at a station whose people have a culture (STATION_CULTURE). One pool per people (03 §2); a local gets one face from its station and bar slot.
generator: OpenAI image generation via codex exec -m gpt-6.1-sol (ChatGPT account); tools/art/imagegen_variants.py (3 variants per two-person sheet, each taken from its own session folder), best passing the reject-list check per person, cut by tools/art/cut_portraits.py (768 px square JPEG, quality 90)
license: Generated for SpaceFace by the project. Two existing portraits (portrait_kessler, portrait_rook) were given as look references only. Every face is an invented person; no real person or third-party photograph was supplied.
briefs: tools/art/culture_portrait_briefs.py holds the shared style frame and each person's brief (a specific life, a justified detail, the capture device) — eight people per culture, one pool per people of 03 §2
